newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell Philippines' dealers cut fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Shell Philippines' dealers cut fuel prices.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp dealers on Monday lowered the pump price of diesel and unleaded premium gasoline by 10 centavos per litre each.
Over 800 Shell dealers nationwide implemented the reduction at 12 noon (0400 GMT), Linda Padlan, president of the Shell Dealers Association told Reuters.
Last Friday, Pilipinas Shell raised wholesale posted prices of petroleum products by an average of 1.46 centavos per litre in line with Singapore posted prices.

Padlan said the price increases were to be used by the dealers as benchmarks but the association decided to seek the approval of Pilipinas Shell to lower the diesel price to 7.50 pesos a litre and unleaded gasoline to 11.08 pesos.
Padlan said the association did not adjust prices of other petroleum products.
"The reduction in diesel will benefit public utility vehicles while lowering of unleaded gasoline will promote the use of the environment-friendly product," Padlan explained.
Shell dealers are the first to have made the reduction.
Pilipinas Shell is a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of companies.
Oil refiners have been freely setting petroleum prices since the industry was deregulated last February.
